title: Transportation
description: Trains, taxis and buses. Heavy on listening — most of this category is announcements and staff replies you need to catch, not sentences you produce.

phrases.japanese: 東京駅までお願いします
phrases.registerNotes: Works for a taxi driver or a ticket window. Swap the place name freely — 〜までお願いします is the whole pattern.
phrases.audioHint: とうきょうえきまでおねがいします

phrases.japanese: 切符はどこで買えますか
phrases.romaji: kippu wa doko de kaemasu ka
phrases.english: Where can I buy a ticket?
phrases.registerNotes: 券売機 (kenbaiki) is the ticket machine; 窓口 (madoguchi) is the staffed window.
phrases.audioHint: きっぷはどこでかえますか

phrases.japanese: 大阪までいくらですか
phrases.english: How much is it to Osaka?
phrases.registerNotes: Combines 〜まで with いくらですか from the numbers category.
phrases.audioHint: おおさかまでいくらですか

phrases.japanese: この電車は京都に行きますか
phrases.romaji: kono densha wa Kyōto ni ikimasu ka
phrases.english: Does this train go to Kyoto?
phrases.registerNotes: The highest-value sentence in this category — answers the 'am I on the right train' panic directly.
phrases.audioHint: このでんしゃはきょうとにいきますか

phrases.japanese: 何番線ですか
phrases.registerNotes: 番線 is the platform-number counter. 三番線 = platform 3.
phrases.audioHint: なんばんせんですか

phrases.japanese: 乗り換えはどこですか
phrases.registerNotes: 乗り換え is written on every transfer sign and said in every announcement. Recognise it first, say it second.
phrases.audioHint: のりかえはどこですか

phrases.japanese: 次の駅はどこですか
phrases.romaji: tsugi no eki wa doko desu ka
phrases.registerNotes: 次は〜です ('next is …') is the exact phrasing of the onboard announcement.
phrases.audioHint: つぎのえきはどこですか

phrases.japanese: ICカードをチャージしたいです

furigana.b: ICカードをチャージしたいです

phrases.romaji: ai-shī kādo o chāji shitai desu
phrases.english: I'd like to top up my IC card.
phrases.registerNotes: Suica / ICOCA / PASMO all work interchangeably on most networks. チャージ is the standard word for topping up — 'top up' won't be understood.
phrases.audioHint: アイシーカードをチャージしたいです

phrases.japanese: 指定席をお願いします
phrases.registerNotes: 指定席 = reserved, 自由席 (じゆうせき) = unreserved. On the shinkansen you'll be asked which you want.
phrases.audioHint: していせきをおねがいします

phrases.japanese: 自由席でいいです
phrases.registerNotes: 〜でいいです = 'that one is fine'. Handy whenever you're offered a choice you don't care about.
phrases.audioHint: じゆうせきでいいです

phrases.japanese: 片道ですか、往復ですか
phrases.romaji: katamichi desu ka, ōfuku desu ka
phrases.registerNotes: Listening target — this is asked to you at the ticket window. Answer 片道です or 往復です.
phrases.audioHint: かたみちですか、おうふくですか

phrases.japanese: 終電は何時ですか
phrases.english: What time is the last train?
phrases.registerNotes: Genuinely important — most city networks stop around midnight and a missed last train means a taxi fare or a capsule hotel.
phrases.audioHint: しゅうでんはなんじですか

phrases.japanese: タクシー乗り場はどこですか
phrases.romaji: takushī noriba wa doko desu ka
phrases.registerNotes: 乗り場 = boarding point — works for taxis, buses and ferries alike.
phrases.audioHint: タクシーのりばはどこですか

phrases.japanese: ここで止めてください
phrases.registerNotes: For a taxi. Don't open the door yourself — the driver operates the rear door.
phrases.audioHint: ここでとめてください

phrases.japanese: この住所までお願いします
phrases.registerNotes: Say it while showing the address on your phone. Far more reliable than pronouncing an unfamiliar place name.
phrases.audioHint: このじゅうしょまでおねがいします

phrases.japanese: このバスは駅に行きますか
phrases.romaji: kono basu wa eki ni ikimasu ka
phrases.english: Does this bus go to the station?
phrases.registerNotes: On many local buses you board at the rear and pay when you get off. Take a numbered ticket (整理券) on boarding.
phrases.audioHint: このバスはえきにいきますか

phrases.japanese: 一日券はありますか
phrases.registerNotes: Most major cities have one for subways and buses. Usually pays for itself in three or four rides.
phrases.audioHint: いちにちけんはありますか

phrases.japanese: 反対方向でした
phrases.registerNotes: Explains your problem in three words at a station office. They will not charge you extra for an honest mistake.
phrases.audioHint: はんたいほうこうでした

phrases.japanese: まもなく発車します
phrases.registerNotes: Recognition only — the standard platform announcement. まもなく = 'soon'. Hearing it means move now.
phrases.audioHint: まもなくはっしゃします

phrases.japanese: 駆け込み乗車はおやめください
phrases.english: Please don't rush onto the train.
phrases.registerNotes: Recognition only. おやめください is the honorific 'please refrain' you'll hear in every public warning announcement.
phrases.audioHint: かけこみじょうしゃはおやめください
